name: @estate/vault-extension
description: The Estate vault BROWSER EXTENSION (docs/03 TB9, M16). Manifest V3, no bundler, no runtime dependencies, hand-written DOM — the isolated vault origin's posture applied to the one artifact that will eventually run beside code we did not write. PR2a is transport only: it pairs, holds an extension-audience session, and reads keyset status through the vault origin's edge. It holds NO key material and imports no crypto.
